snippet.title: Summerhill - Official Teaser Trailer 🐑 | Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
🐑 Wishlist & follow #Summerhill on Steam: http://summerhill.game/steam

Immerse yourself in the pastoral world of Summerhill, a story-driven puzzle-adventure game in which you play as a young shepherd and their dog. Venture into the mysterious lands that border your home to rescue your lost flock and unearth the secrets of its long-forgotten past.

From the BAFTA-nominated development team behind the critically acclaimed Alto’s Adventure series, Summerhill brings together gentle problem solving, fluid herding-based gameplay and striking pastoral landscapes to tell a timeless coming-of-age folktale.

Find out more about Summerhill: https://www.summerhill.game/ 
Join our mailing list: https://www.summerhill.game/#MailingList
